text.ms: Bajet yang baik mula dengan menulis dulu apa yang wajib dibayar, seperti sewa, makan dan tambang, sebelum belanja benda lain.
text.en: A good budget starts by writing down what must be paid first, like rent, food and fares, before spending on anything else.

why.ms: Yang wajib diasingkan dulu, baru baki boleh dibelanjakan dengan tenang.
why.en: Set the must-pays aside first, then spend the rest with a calm mind.

text.ms: Elaun RM600 baru masuk. Mana lebih elok?
text.en: Your RM600 allowance just came in. Which is better?

options.ms: Terus beli kasut RM250, lepas tu tengok apa tinggal
options.en: Buy the RM250 shoes straight away, then see what is left

options.ms: Asingkan sewa dan makan dulu, baru tengok baki untuk kasut
options.en: Set aside rent and food first, then see what is left for the shoes

why.ms: Wajib dulu, 'nak' kemudian. Kasut tetap boleh dibeli bila baki cukup.
why.en: Needs first, wants after. The shoes can still be bought when the balance allows.

text.ms: Langganan RM9.90 sebulan nampak kecil, tapi setahun jadi RM118.80.
text.en: A RM9.90 monthly subscription looks small, but over a year it adds up to RM118.80.

why.ms: RM9.90 darab 12 bulan ialah RM118.80. Kos kecil yang berulang pun perlu masuk bajet.
why.en: RM9.90 times 12 months is RM118.80. Small repeating costs belong in the budget too.

text.ms: Kawan ajak makan mewah hujung bulan, duit tinggal RM40. Apa buat?
text.en: A friend invites you to a fancy dinner at month end and you have RM40 left. What do you do?

options.ms: Pergi juga, nanti fikir macam mana
options.en: Go anyway and figure it out later

options.ms: Cakap terus terang, cadang tempat murah atau minggu depan
options.en: Be honest, and suggest somewhere cheaper or next week

why.ms: Kawan sebenar faham. Berterus terang tak memalukan.
why.en: Real friends understand. Being open is nothing to be embarrassed about.

text.ms: Dana kecemasan ialah duit simpanan asing untuk perkara tak dijangka, seperti telefon rosak atau pergi klinik.
text.en: An emergency fund is separate savings for the unexpected, like a broken phone or a clinic visit.

why.ms: Duit ini bukan untuk membeli barang, ia untuk tak terpaksa berhutang bila kecemasan datang.
why.en: This money is not for shopping. It saves you from borrowing when an emergency comes.

text.ms: Duit kecemasan elok diletak di tempat yang boleh diambil bila-bila, bukan di tempat yang nilainya naik turun.
text.en: Emergency money is best kept where you can take it out any time, not where its value goes up and down.

why.ms: Waktu kecemasan, anda perlu jumlah yang sama dan terus ada.
why.en: In an emergency you need the same amount, available right away.

text.ms: Telefon rosak dan anda ada RM300 simpanan kecemasan. Apa langkah lebih baik?
text.en: Your phone breaks and you have RM300 in emergency savings. What is the better step?

options.ms: Guna simpanan itu, lepas tu isi semula perlahan-lahan
options.en: Use the savings, then refill it slowly

options.ms: Pinjam daripada apl pinjaman segera sebab cepat
options.en: Borrow from a quick-loan app because it is fast

why.ms: Itulah gunanya dana kecemasan. Pinjaman segera biasanya bawa caj tambahan.
why.en: That is what the fund is for. Quick loans usually come with extra charges.

text.ms: RM50 sebulan selama 10 tahun pada 5% setahun (contoh) jadi lebih RM7,700.
text.en: RM50 a month for 10 years at 5% a year (example) becomes more than RM7,700.

why.ms: Simpan RM6,000, kompaun tambah lebih RM1,700 jadi kira-kira RM7,764. Contoh sahaja.
why.en: You save RM6,000 and compounding adds over RM1,700, about RM7,764. Example only.

text.ms: Menyimpan jumlah yang sama setiap bulan, yang mula awal biasanya dapat lebih banyak daripada yang mula lambat, dengan kadar contoh yang sama.
text.en: Saving the same amount each month, the one who starts earlier usually ends up with more than the one who starts late, at the same example rate.

why.ms: Duit yang lebih lama menyimpan dapat lebih banyak masa untuk bertambah. Contoh sahaja.
why.en: Money kept longer has more time to grow. Example only.

text.ms: Dua orang simpan RM50 sebulan pada kadar contoh yang sama hingga umur 30. Siapa dapat lebih?
text.en: Two people save RM50 a month at the same example rate until age 30. Who ends up with more?

why.ms: Mula umur 19 simpan lebih lama, jadi lebih banyak masa untuk kompaun. Contoh sahaja.
why.en: Starting at 19 means saving longer, so more time to compound. Example only.

text.ms: Faedah kompaun hanya dikira atas jumlah asal, bukan atas untung yang sudah ditambah.
text.en: Compound interest is only worked out on the original amount, not on profit already added.

why.ms: Kompaun bermaksud untung pun menghasilkan untung. Itu yang buat ia membesar makin laju.
why.en: Compounding means profit earns profit too. That is why it grows faster over time.

text.ms: Tawaran yang janji untung tinggi dan tiada risiko boleh dipercayai.
text.en: An offer that promises high profit and no risk can be trusted.

why.ms: Untung tinggi sentiasa datang dengan risiko. Janji tiada risiko ialah tanda amaran.
why.en: High profit always comes with risk. A promise of no risk is a warning sign.

text.ms: Dana Ekuiti Cempaka turun 6% (contoh) minggu ini. Apa langkah lebih bijak?
text.en: Dana Ekuiti Cempaka fell 6% (example) this week. Which step is wiser?

options.ms: Semak sebab, dan fikir berapa lama anda sanggup tunggu
options.en: Check the reason, and think how long you can wait
Panic and sell everything at once

why.ms: Harga naik turun itu biasa. Keputusan dalam panik jarang elok. Contoh sahaja.
why.en: Prices going up and down is normal. Decisions made in panic are rarely good. Example only.

text.ms: Pelaburan sebenar boleh turun nilai. Yang tak pernah turun langsung patut buat kita curiga.
text.en: A real investment can lose value. One that never goes down at all should make us suspicious.

why.ms: Keuntungan yang sentiasa licin tanpa naik turun selalunya cerita yang direka.
why.en: Profits that are always smooth with no ups and downs are often an invented story.

text.ms: Beli sekarang, bayar nanti tidak percuma: lewat bayar boleh kena caj tambahan.
text.en: Buy now, pay later is not free: paying late can bring extra charges.

why.ms: Baca caj lewat sebelum setuju. Bayaran yang dipecah tetap hutang.
why.en: Read the late fees before agreeing. Split payments are still a debt.

text.ms: Nak beli telefon RM1,000. Pilihan mana lebih murah secara keseluruhan?
text.en: You want a RM1,000 phone. Which option costs less overall?

options.ms: Simpan RM100 sebulan, beli bila cukup
options.en: Save RM100 a month and buy when you have enough

options.ms: Ansuran 12 bulan dengan caj tambahan contoh RM180
options.en: 12 monthly instalments with an example extra charge of RM180

why.ms: Menunggu bayar RM1,000 sahaja, ansuran contoh jadi RM1,180. Contoh sahaja.
why.en: Waiting costs just RM1,000, while the example instalments total RM1,180. Example only.

text.ms: Pemberi pinjaman yang sah tidak akan minta kad ATM atau PIN anda sebagai cagaran.
text.en: A legitimate lender will not ask for your ATM card or PIN as security.

why.ms: Kad dan PIN anda kunci kepada duit anda. Minta benda itu ialah tanda pinjaman tidak berlesen.
why.en: Your card and PIN are the key to your money. Asking for them is a sign of an unlicensed loan.

text.ms: Sebelum percaya sesebuah syarikat atau tawaran, semak melalui laman atau nombor rasmi yang anda cari sendiri, bukan yang datang dalam mesej.
text.en: Before trusting a company or offer, check through the official site or number you look up yourself, not the one in the message.

why.ms: Penipu beri pautan dan nombor palsu. Cari sendiri supaya anda pasti.
why.en: Scammers supply fake links and numbers. Look it up yourself to be sure.

text.ms: Mesej kata akaun anda disekat dan beri pautan untuk 'buka sekatan'. Apa buat?
text.en: A message says your account is blocked and gives a link to 'unblock'. What do you do?

options.ms: Tekan pautan sebab takut akaun hilang
options.en: Tap the link because you fear losing the account

options.ms: Tutup mesej, hubungi nombor di belakang kad
options.en: Close the message and call the number on the back of your card

why.ms: Guna saluran yang anda sendiri tahu betul. Tiada rugi menyemak dulu.
why.en: Use a channel you know is real. Nothing is lost by checking first.

text.ms: Kalau ramai orang kongsi sesuatu tawaran, bermakna tawaran itu sah.
text.en: If lots of people share an offer, it means the offer is real.

why.ms: Ramai kongsi tak bukti apa-apa. Penipuan pun boleh tersebar. Semak sumber sebenar.
why.en: Many shares prove nothing. Scams spread too. Check the real source.
